content: After that, link boundaries are adjusted by removing the labels for expressions in parentheses, the text after a comma, and in some cases breaking into separate named entities if the linked text contains a comma. For example, [LOC Աբովյան (քաղաք)] (Abovyan (town)) is reworked into [LOC Աբովյան] (քաղաք).
